title: Banned Books Week Read-In
summary: A free community read-in at Scribbles and Quills in Lange Park, Chaguanas, for Banned Books Week.
description: Scribbles and Quills is hosting a free Banned Books Week Read-In on Wednesday 7 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Attendees can bring a banned or challenged book, bring their current read, or choose a book from the shop and join an evening of reading, community and conversation.
